intent: Integrate reviewed Claude trial5 fixes, close omitted join evidence and nested-section holes, and add reproducible transfer validation inputs with bounded replay.

findings.title: Stamp uses a different section boundary and writes into an Answer subheading
findings.suggested_fix: Use the same hierarchy-aware heading selection for stamping and verification; add a regression with a Provenance-named subheading before the real Provenance section.
findings.why_it_matters: The new parser correctly keeps ### Provenance by segment inside Answer, but --stamp writes Verified there instead of in the actual Provenance section, violating the documented stamp contract.
evidence: Constructed an Answer with ### Provenance by segment, followed by ## Provenance. stamp() placed Verified in the former; real Provenance had no Verified.
